nodes.label: Tiswell Logo Lockup
nodes.rationale: Square master brand asset for Tiswell, the sibling application to Manna. Vertical lockup: the concentric-arc mark sits above a lowercase wordmark on a flat cream field, with no tagline, no border, and no drop shadow. The square 1:1 framing and generous margin make the same file usable as an avatar, store listing tile, or splash image without recomposition.

nodes.label: Tiswell Wordmark
nodes.rationale: Set entirely in lowercase as 'tiswell' in a soft geometric sans with rounded terminals and wide letter tracking, coloured in the darkest brown of the palette. Lowercase-only and rounded terminals keep the tone domestic and unassuming rather than corporate, matching an app about possessions you already own.
